rows.label: expt:devperf:design-correspondence
rows.measurement: Owner-reported quiet observation, approximately twenty seconds; no controlled raw baseline attached yet
rows.name: design-correspondence
rows.placement: existing per-change gate; retain the check while the warning is investigated
rows.reason: The complete label, dataset and document relation must be checked; deleting cases or replacing the full scan with a partial check would weaken evidence. Whether indexing or shared parsing makes this fast remains to be measured, so unavoidable cost is not yet established.
rows.settlement: Profile the full workload, publish repeated quiet samples and attempted reductions, then admit the measured residual or withdraw the candidate; until admission the ordinary-check budget remains effective
